item.title: From M&S pants to fancy skincare: the celebrity shopping recommendations you loved the most
item.summary: Whether it’s expensive regrets or brilliant bargains, we celebrate the stars’ shopping secrets – and the products that tempted you • Don’t get the Filter delivered to your inbox? Sign up here Like snooping in someone else’s supermarket trolley, discovering other people’s shopping habits satisfies a certain nosiness. And never more so than when it comes to celebrities – there’s nothing more human than knowing Kim Cattrall loves fish and chips, or that Henry Holland is a Skims guy. And as celebrities often have the inside track – or perhaps we just think they do – on everything from coffee machines to skincare, their recommendations in our biweekly How I Shop column have inspired more than a few of your own retail habits. In some cases, however, such as David Gandy ’s £2,500 Cobra Fortis lawnmower , the price was a little too out of reach. Continue reading...
